> 三十二 悔恨（第1页）
听到蓝烨磊的问话，沈傲珊笑了起来。
“呵呵……，你只猜对了一半，另一半，是你每天早晨喝的桂花茶，那是我独家特制的桂花茶。花茶与熏香，两者单独使用，都是极品，且不会有什么反应。但是桂花茶与梅花味的熏香一起，便会令人意乱情迷，无论面对的是什么人，都会觉得是与自己心爱的人在一起。所以当你看到我的时候，以为是和沈沛珊在一起。我知道，在你心中她的位置很重，也知道你爱她，即使是刚才，你口中喊的珊儿我知道你也是喊的她。可是我不介意，我只要能与你在一起，我就知足了。”
沈傲珊再次搂住蓝烨磊，“磊哥哥，我去与父亲说，让他同意我嫁与你，可好？”
此刻的蓝烨磊心里乱作一团，“我刚与沛珊新婚，就纳你为妾，这让我怎样面对她？你让我怎样与她说我和你刚才做的事？”蓝烨磊不禁有些愤怒，用力的推开沈傲珊。
沈傲珊跌坐在床上，揉着手臂，委屈的说道：“磊哥哥，你弄疼我了。我知道我与你做的事，不是你心甘情愿的，可是你也没有吃亏不是？平白占了我这女儿身，纳御史府的小姐为妾还委屈了你不成么？再说，刚才姐姐已经看到你与我在一起了。我想，你也不必与她解释了。”
“什么？”蓝烨磊如遭雷击一般，呆立在房间中央。
事情就是那么顺理成章的成了定局，沈傲珊名正言顺的成了将军府的二夫人。沈沛珊因为这件事一直都不能原谅蓝烨磊与沈傲珊，她无法接受前一刻还与自己信誓旦旦说要一辈子在一起的男人，下一刻却与另外一个女人在床上忘情的翻云覆雨。
蓝烨磊也不能原谅自己的行为，甚至讨厌沈傲珊，不愿与她同房，每日独宿在书房。想起往日与沈沛珊的甜蜜，不由得伤感惋惜。
沈傲珊自是不能容忍蓝烨磊这样待自己，她是个时刻都需要成为焦点的女人。于是她想尽了办法与蓝烨磊接近，但是蓝烨磊始终与她保持着距离。
天气越来越冷，院子里的雪有近一尺厚。
清风阁里生起了火炉，沈沛珊坐在窗边，看着窗外的雪景。
肚子里的宝宝已经五个月大了，现在所有的怀孕反应都已经消失，平静下来的沈沛珊，已经不再去想所有的是是非非，肚子里的孩子，成为她心中最大的期盼。
若不是在野猫谷中长大，恐怕这种平静的日子也会让她疯掉。两个月的时间，让她已经习惯没有蓝烨磊的生活，每日除了吃饭睡觉，就是与齐嬷嬷给未出世的宝宝做些衣服裤子棉服棉被什么的。
她的淡然，让蓝烨磊有些害怕，想与她亲近，却被她的高傲冷漠拒之门外，甚至连解释的话语都说不出口。
看到蓝烨磊出现在院子里，沈沛珊低头继续做着小衣服。现在的她，把所有的爱都放在未出世的孩子身上。

The latest chapter of The Reborn Daughter Wushuang_Thirty-two Regrets Page 1_The Reborn Daughter Wushuang Ruffian Snow_Hot Novel Network
> Thirty-two Regret (Page 1)
Hearing Lan Yelei's question, Shen Aoshan laughed.
"Haha... you only guessed half of it right. The other half is the osmanthus tea you drink every morning. It is my exclusive osmanthus tea. Scented tea and incense are both top-quality when used alone, and there will be no reaction. But the combination of osmanthus tea and plum blossom-flavored incense will make people confused and fascinated, no matter who they are facing. I feel like I'm with the one I love. So when you saw me, you thought you were with Shen Peishan. I know that she holds a very important place in your heart, and I know that you love her. Even if you called her Shan'er just now, I know you meant her. But I don't mind, as long as I can be with you, I'll be satisfied."
Shen Aoshan hugged Lan Yelei again, "Brother Lei, I'm going to tell my father and ask him to agree to my marrying you, okay?"
At this moment, Lan Yelei was in a state of confusion, "I just married Peishan, and I took you as my concubine. How do I face her? How do you want me to tell her what I just did with you?" Lan Yelei couldn't help but feel a little angry, and pushed Shen Aoshan away hard.
Shen Aoshan fell down on the bed, rubbed her arms, and said aggrievedly: "Brother Lei, you hurt me. I know that what I did with you was not what you wanted to do, but you didn't suffer, right? Isn't it wrong for you to take my daughter as your concubine for nothing? Besides, my sister has seen you and me together just now. I think you don't have to explain to her."
"What?" Lan Yelei stood stunned in the center of the room as if struck by lightning.
Things became a foregone conclusion naturally, and Shen Aoshan became the second wife of the General's Mansion. Shen Peishan has never been able to forgive Lan Yelei and Shen Aoshan because of this incident. She can't accept that the man who vowed to be with her forever one moment, is in bed with another woman and becomes obsessed with each other the next moment.
Lan Yelei could not forgive his behavior. He even hated Shen Aoshan and did not want to share the same room with her. He stayed alone in the study every day. Thinking of the sweetness with Shen Peishan in the past, I couldn't help but feel sad and regretful.
Shen Aoshan couldn't tolerate Lan Yelei treating her like this. She was a woman who always needed to be the center of attention. So she tried her best to get close to Lan Yelei, but Lan Yelei always kept a distance from her.
The weather is getting colder and colder, and there is nearly a foot of snow in the yard.
A stove was lit in Qingfeng Pavilion, and Shen Peishan sat by the window, looking at the snowy scene outside the window.
The baby in her belly is already five months old. Now all the pregnancy reactions have disappeared. Shen Peishan has calmed down and no longer thinks about all the right and wrong. The baby in her belly has become the biggest expectation in her heart.
If she hadn't grown up in Wild Cat Valley, this kind of peaceful life might have driven her crazy. In two months, she had gotten used to a life without Lan Yelei. In addition to eating and sleeping every day, she and Aunt Qi made clothes, pants, quilts, and quilts for the unborn baby.
Her indifference made Lan Yelei a little scared. He wanted to get close to her, but was turned away by her arrogance and indifference, and he couldn't even utter an explanation.
Seeing Lan Yelei appear in the yard, Shen Peishan lowered her head and continued to make small clothes. Now she puts all her love on her unborn child.
